description.p: Lunduke City is a windowed city-building game for LCOS, built on the Micropolis simulation engine. Zone land, lay roads and power, set the budget, and watch the city grow, with the classic scenarios from Dullsville to Rio de Janeiro.
Cities are saved as .cty files. Unsaved work is autosaved and offered back after a crash or logout.
Autosave with crash and logout recovery, Open Recent, saving through a symbolic link, keeping a shared file's group, cleanup of leftover temporary save files, and this AppStream metadata.
Review fixes: safer loading and saving of city files, a Help menu, Save As shortcut, and windows that fit small screens.
